author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Researchers have developed a 4.4 mm long micro-robot capable of performing five distinct surgical tasks using external magnetic fields. This soft, biocompatible robot can crawl, cut tissue, deliver drugs, perform biopsies, and apply localized heating without onboard electronics.

Source Article: https://advanced.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/adma.202523056
